title: Frog Prince
tagline: Find your significant other through baby photos and change them throughout conversation
description: Time to date! This project show you what the future baby between you and your potential match look like! As you converse with your potential date, the baby photo will be updated to reflect what you like to do what what you don't like to do. You no longer need to be stuck with a boring profile but a fun and evolving baby photos as you chat with people from around the world!
how_its_made: We use Bubble.io for no-code web app builder coupled with a local server to interact with smart contracts. We needed to figure out how to add custom api calls to bubble app and how to route the request to smart contract. It allows our frontend experts to design and build the UI without having to know about writing codes.
